name: Storyteller (woman)
about: A calm adult woman telling a memory. Calm words on purpose (the card voice leaves them out: they slow a line). One voice for every line of a listening round: this caption and seed 7 on each, speed 1.1. No reference clip. PROVISIONAL.
caption: 落ち着いた大人の女性の声。淡々と語りつつ、少し懐かしさをにじませて話している。
